title: The Glad Tiding in Old Age
intro: You are witnessing a moment where hope is rekindled. A couple, long past the age of parenthood, receives a promise that defies the laws of nature. In their midst stands a figure whose very existence is a sign of divine mercy—a soul destined for prophethood, carrying a legacy that will span generations. Who is this remarkable individual?
clues: I was born to parents who had reached old age and had no children.
My birth was announced by angels who came as guests to my family.
I was given wisdom and prophethood, and I am mentioned among the patient.
My father was called the friend of Allah, and I was a gift to him in his later years.
I had a brother who was also a prophet, and we were both blessed by our Lord.
My son was also a prophet, and my descendants were given the scripture and prophethood.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
